items.prompt: Where do my widgets live when I put them on a shelf?
items.ten_second: Your widgets live on a shelf in one Region. They stay there until you copy the shelf.
sixty_second: The short answer is: a shelf keeps your widgets in one Region.
It works like this. You choose a Region when you create the shelf.
The widgets on that shelf stay in that Region.
One shelf holds up to five hundred widgets.
The thing to watch is this: you can't move a shelf to another Region.
If you need the widgets somewhere else, you copy the shelf.
In your case, I'd keep one shelf in Frankfurt for the customers in Germany.
Do you expect customers in a second Region this year?

key_points.point: A shelf stores widgets in one Region.
accept: the widgets stay in the Region of the shelf

key_points.point: You cannot move a shelf to another Region; you copy the shelf.

follow_ups.question: Can I move the shelf when we open an office in Tokyo?
follow_ups.answer: No. You copy the shelf to the Tokyo Region and keep the first shelf.

follow_ups.question: Who can read a shelf that I create today?
follow_ups.answer: At first, only you. A new shelf is private by default.
